EFS/S09.title: Billing suggestion fails on a stored note and right after a (mocked) Generate: note stays, error with retry, no old code (both contexts)
EFS/S09.detail: Hospital and Nursing Home; spec newspec-c/flt-efs-s09-billing-fail.spec.ts. Every ai/notes:suggestBilling call fails at the socket; generateNote is answered at the socket with a note built from the typed encounter. Judged 28/28. (a) Chart with a generated note and no billing: the note is on Post-Round; the billing card says 'Couldn't generate billing suggestion — tap to retry'; no 'CODE:' and no 9922x/9923x/9930x/9931x code on screen; the stored note is untouched and no code was stored. (b) Chart with an earlier note and its code (CODE: 99233 Hospital / CODE: 99309 Nursing Home): typed ' QA-EFS-09B Walked 150 feet…', Regenerate Note; the new note ('150 feet') is on Post-Round with Copy to EMR, the billing card shows the same error with retry, the earlier note's code is not shown, no note-failure message, and the new note is stored. Recorded: one tap on the retry asks again (1 → 2 calls) and shows the error again; the earlier code is still stored but tied to the earlier note's timestamp, so it is never displayed for the new note.
